# Ellangala’s Academy

> Ellangala’s Academy is an educational and mental wellness institution founded by Dr. Naveen Ellangala, dedicated to evidence-informed Positive Psychology, emotional resilience, mind training, personal growth, and practical philosophy for purposeful living.

Founded by Dr. Naveen Ellangala (Ph.D. in Positive Psychology, Author of 17 books, Certified NLP Counselor, CBT Practitioner). Headquartered at 410, C Block, Radiant Karel, Nayandahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka – 560039, India. Contact: info@ellangala.com, +91-99867-44700. Primary service area is Karnataka, India, with additional reach into Kerala; programs and publications are offered in both English and Kannada, including a dedicated Kannada-language book collection. Doctoral research formulates an indigenous PERMA model of Positive Psychology grounded in the literary works of Purandaradasa, the 16th-century Haridasa saint-composer revered in Karnataka’s cultural and musical heritage.

## Core Offerings & Pages

- [Home](https://ellangala.com/)
- [About](https://ellangala.com/about)
- [Founder Profile](https://ellangala.com/founder): Dr. Naveen Ellangala’s biography, credentials, and vision.
- [Doctoral Research](https://ellangala.com/research): A PERMA model of Positive Psychology grounded in the literary works of Purandaradasa.
- [Positive Workshops](https://ellangala.com/positive-workshops): Experiential learning on Stress Mastery, Emotional Intelligence, Teacher Transformation, Mindful Parenting, and Student Excellence, conducted across Bengaluru and Karnataka.
- [Positive Mentoring](https://ellangala.com/positive-mentoring): Confidential 1-on-1 personalized guidance for individuals, professionals, students, and parents, in Bengaluru and online.
- [Positive MindGym](https://ellangala.com/mindgym): A daily mental fitness regimen combining mindfulness routines, cognitive reframing, habit tracking, and emotional hygiene exercises.
- [Store & Books](https://ellangala.com/shop): 17 authored books and daily positive affirmation decks, including a dedicated Kannada-language collection.
- [Bhagavad Gita for a Meaningful Life (Free Workbook)](https://ellangala.com/free-resources): A free chapter-by-chapter reflection workbook on the Bhagavad Gita, available in English and Kannada.
- [Videos on Talks](https://ellangala.com/videos): Free keynote talks, masterclasses, and mind training video lectures.
- [Daily Feed](https://ellangala.com/feed): Daily wisdom, reflections, and guided audio mind workouts.
- [FAQ](https://ellangala.com/faq)
- [Contact](https://ellangala.com/contact)
